shortDescription: Manage Resource Authorization Policies (RAP) on a Remote Desktop Gateway server

options.name: allowed_ports
options.description: List of port numbers through which connections are allowed for this policy. To allow connections through any port, specify 'any'.

options.name: computer_group
options.description: The computer group name that is associated with this resource authorization policy (RAP). This is required when I(computer_group_type) is C(rdg_group) or C(ad_network_resource_group).

options.name: computer_group_type
options.description: The computer group type: C(rdg_group): RD Gateway-managed group C(ad_network_resource_group): Active Directory Domain Services network resource group C(allow_any): Allow users to connect to any network resource.

options.name: description
options.description: Optional description of the resource authorization policy.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the resource authorization policy.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of resource authorization policy. If C(absent) will ensure the policy is removed. If C(present) will ensure the policy is configured and exists. If C(enabled) will ensure the policy is configured, exists and enabled. If C(disabled) will ensure the policy is configured, exists, but disabled.

options.name: user_groups
options.description: List of user groups that are associated with this resource authorization policy (RAP). A user must belong to one of these groups to access the RD Gateway server. Required when a new RAP is created.
